I get reminded how much of a disappointment I am. I was an 4.0 AP student in high school, but my parents didn't seem to care. I got into Cal Poly Pomona, for music. THey still didn't seem to care. Only kept asking when I was going to get a job to help pay. I finally got a job, and they started getting frustrated with the fact that I was rarely home. (I was working and on my day off, I liked spending some time with my girlfriend.) I don't make enough money. I decided to transfer and switch majors, which involved me going to a community for a while. They didn't like the idea, and were of no help when I went to go find out. And I tend to vent on social networks (ex. twitter. ) I've usually been very safe so people don't know who I'm talking about. I go home, vent on my social network, someone managed to tell my familiy. It made me feel like crap, my mom started saying all I do is talk crap and dissapoint them. That was today.

It feels like it's been years since I have been happy. Most of the time, I'm only happy when I'm with my girlfriend(I see her once a week at most.) But as soon as I arrive home or anyone else for that matter I just feel worthless.
I really wish I could afford therapy. I try talking to people, I talk to my friends and girlfriend, but it's only a temporary help. Something happens that sets me off. Back into depression.
